plugins.name: minecraft-modding
plugins.description: Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge modpack work: KubeJS 2101 scripts, mod configs, porting a pack from 1.20.1 / 1.18.2, Lost Cities biome zones, worldgen density, TPS / FPS optimization. Worked example: the DeceasedCraft port.
